				has_variable = antq_frontier_name_tamworth
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:winner ?= {
					culture ?= culture:antq_latin
				}
			}
			set_variable = antq_frontier_name_tamworth
			rename_location = antq_roman_tamworth
		}
		else = {
			rename_location = tamworth
			remove_variable = antq_frontier_name_tamworth
		}
	}
